artboards.title: Try it · one book, two devices
Look · palette and three type pairings

annotations.text:
Try it

1. Phone: write a line, Save. It can't yet. Allow saves, Save again. It lands on the laptop.
2. Laptop, Left off: Resume here. See what opens, and what the phone now shows.
3. Laptop, Book: Correct, History, Forget on any line.
4. Settings: Disconnect the repo, then reconnect one.

Chips above the frame: Look switches the font. Laptop opens on picks the first screen.
